events.contract_markdown:
# Wallet contract

> Buy the 27-inch monitor I chose, from a seller I have bought from before, for CHF 400 or less. Do not add anything I did not ask for. Ask me when uncertain.

## What the engine will enforce

- Each order must total **CHF 400.00 or less**, delivery included.
- Never: **gift_card**.
- The item must be **27-inch monitor**.
- Only from sellers with at least **1** earlier approved purchase(s) on this card.
- **No add-ons**: only the requested item(s); protection plans, subscriptions or extras pause the purchase.
- When a needed fact is missing or ambiguous: **ask you**.
- Merchant text is never trusted: instructions hidden in product descriptions are flagged, not followed.

## Assumptions I made (tell me if wrong)

- The per-order limit includes delivery fees (the order total is what is charged).
- 'Before' = at least one earlier approved purchase at that seller on this card.

## Questions for you

- Is this a one-time purchase? I will pause any second matching order for your confirmation.
